The masthead carries the working-paper identity; the body demonstrates the
type it governs — *italic*, **bold** (ExtraBold, the display weight), `code`
set in IBM Plex Mono, and a footnote[^1].

[^1]: Footnotes set small in Libre Franklin.

| Surface | Set in |
|---|---|
| Title | Libre Franklin ExtraBold |
| Series line | IBM Plex Mono, letter-spaced |
